level.setting: A rain-soaked, neon-lit derelict tech refinery. The air hums with electrical energy, and flickering holograms project warnings about the unstable reactor core.

pickup.name: Reactor Access Keycard
pickup.effect: Unlocks Reactor Access Panel

encounters.trigger: Defeat the drone to activate the Reactor Access Panel

pickup.name: Neural Disruptor
pickup.effect: Disables enemy turrets and grants a Neural Disruptor

encounters.trigger: Use the Reactor Access Keycard to enter the Control Room

pickup.name: Core Stability Override
pickup.effect: Unlocks the final phase of the boss fight

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Cybernetic Guard to access the Core Reactor Chamber

boss.name: Neural Overmind
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the corrupted AI by targeting its core with the Neural Disruptor

level.objective: Infiltrate the refinery, defeat three enemies, and destroy the corrupted AI controlling the facility
level.reward: Neural Disruptor, Reactor Access Keycard, Core Stability Override

level.theme: Chaotic urban warfare in a decaying tech hub, with environmental hazards and unpredictable enemy behavior.
level.setting: A dystopian cyberpunk city with collapsing skyscrapers, neon lights, and a constant downpour of acidic rain.
level.player_weapon: Monomolecular Wire (can cut through metal and disable tech)

encounters.location: Neon-lit alleyways of the Lower Grid

pickup.name: Stealth Enhancer
pickup.effect: Increases player's stealth ability by 20% (hidden until used)

encounters.trigger: Player must disable the drone's laser grid by slicing through its power core with the monomolecular wire.

encounters.location: Abandoned data vault with flickering holographic ads
encounters.hazard: Random EMP pulses from nearby malfunctioning tech

pickup.name: Neural Disruptor
pickup.effect: Disables enemy EMP abilities for 10 seconds (active on pickup)

encounters.trigger: Player must hack the vault's security terminal to unlock the path, but the Hacker-Drone intercepts them.

encounters.location: Ruined dojo with glowing circuitry embedded in the floor
encounters.hazard: Collapsing ceiling panels and toxic gas leaks

pickup.name: Blade Resonator
pickup.effect: Unlocks a brutal takedown move (active for 15 seconds after pickup)

encounters.trigger: Player must defeat the Cyber-Samurai to access the hidden chamber where the boss awaits.

boss.name: Neuro-Synapse
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss by exploiting the neural disruptor weakness.

level.objective: Navigate the chaotic Lower Grid, defeat three enemies with precise weapon use and pickups, and exploit the neural disruptor to defeat the final boss.
level.reward: Neuro-Synapse's cybernetic core (boosts player's cyberware capacity by 2 levels)

level.theme: Mysterious cyberpunk setting with hidden terminals, corrupted AI, and a sense of foreboding as the player delves deeper into the server farm.
level.setting: Neon Veil Server Farm: A decaying, flickering server complex beneath the city, filled with malfunctioning drones and encrypted terminals. The air hums with static, and walls are lined with broken servers and glowing circuitry.

enemy.name: Sentinel-7 (Rogue AI Drone)
enemy.weakness: Player's starting weapon: plasma cutter (overloads power core at close range)

pickup.name: Neural Disruptor Module
pickup.effect: Neural Disruptor Module (interferes with neural networks)

encounters.trigger: Triggered by breaching the server bay's security grid

enemy.name: K-9 Revenant (Cybernetic Enforcer)
enemy.weakness: Neural Disruptor Module (disables the enforcer's neural matrix)

pickup.name: Cipher Key
pickup.effect: Cipher Key (decrypts secure systems)

encounters.trigger: Triggered by disabling the guard station's security system with the Neural Disruptor Module

pickup.name: Pathway to Nexus-Ω
pickup.effect: Unlocks the path to the boss chamber

encounters.trigger: Triggered by bypassing the cipher lock with the Cipher Key

boss.name: Nexus-Ω
boss.victory_condition: Disrupt the energy field with the Cipher Key and destroy the core

level.objective: Retrieve the data chip from the corrupted AI core

level.setting: A derelict underground tech facility beneath Neo-Tokyo, filled with flickering holograms, leaking coolant, and ghostly echoes of past experiments. The air smells of ozone and burnt circuitry.

encounters.hazard: Malfunctioning neon lights flicker violently, casting shadows that distort time briefly.

pickup.name: Chrono Core
pickup.effect: Grants +15% Temporal Energy regeneration.

encounters.trigger: Player triggers a hidden motion sensor by interacting with a corrupted terminal.

encounters.hazard: The air hums with static; player's vision glitches with overlapping timelines.

pickup.name: Data Chip
pickup.effect: Reveals the boss's weakness via a corrupted hologram.

encounters.trigger: Player deciphers the Chrono Core's energy signature to unlock the vault door.

encounters.hazard: Time fractures into looping cycles; player must avoid repeating the same mistakes.

pickup.name: Chrono Catalyst
pickup.effect: Restores 100% Temporal Energy and unlocks a permanent ability: 'Time Lock' (invincibility for 3 seconds).

encounters.trigger: Player follows the Data Chip's signal to the reactor core, where the boss awakens upon their arrival.

boss.name: The Chrono Warden
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the central core using the Data Chip to disable its temporal shields.

level.objective: Reach the central reactor core and destroy the Chrono Warden.

level.setting: A derelict megacity district with flickering neon lights, overgrown with vines, abandoned vehicles, and remnants of old tech. The air hums with the static of corrupted AI and the distant wail of malfunctioning drones.

pickup.name: Neural Override Code
pickup.effect: Unlock Neural Override Code

encounters.trigger: Activate corrupted drone's power core

enemy.name: Cybernetic Enforcer
enemy.weakness: Electromagnetic Pulse (EMP) via Neural Override Code

pickup.name: Thermal Battery Core
pickup.effect: Power Thermal Battery Core

encounters.trigger: Use Neural Override Code to bypass security

pickup.name: Boss Access Key
pickup.effect: Activate Boss Chamber

encounters.trigger: Destroy drone swarm's heat shield

boss.name: Neural Overlord
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core with the Thermal Battery Core

level.objective: Infiltrate the corrupted AI's stronghold and destroy its core
level.reward: Neural Overlord's Core (adds 50% damage to all cybernetic enemies)

level.setting: Derelict NovaCorp Tower, a ruined skyscraper with flickering neon lights and malfunctioning tech. The environment is desolate, with rain, collapsed structures, and distant sounds of malfunctioning machinery.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing elevator shaft with falling debris

pickup.name: Plasma Capacitor Mod
pickup.effect: Enhances plasma pistol with EMP charge capability

encounters.trigger: Disables security system, unlocking elevator to server room

pickup.name: Neural Jack
pickup.effect: Allows hacking of AI systems

encounters.trigger: Triggers AI lockdown, activating the boss fight

encounters.hazard: Phase-shifting AI drones and data storms

pickup.name: Data Core
pickup.effect: Grants access to NovaCorp data vault

encounters.trigger: None

boss.name: Ghost in the Machine
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the AI core with the Neural Jack

level.setting: A whimsical cyberpunk city of floating platforms, neon-lit amusement parks, and rogue AI. Rain falls in rhythmic patterns, and giant disco balls cast prismatic light across the levels.

pickup.name: Neon Capacitor
pickup.effect: Increases energy reserves by 25%

encounters.trigger: Defeat the drone to power the arcade's central console

pickup.name: Quantum Coil
pickup.effect: Increases lightning attack speed by 30%

encounters.trigger: Use the Neon Capacitor to overload the bazaar's security grid

pickup.name: Stormcaller's Crest
pickup.effect: Unlocks permanent 'Lightning Surge' ability

encounters.trigger: Use the Quantum Coil to bypass the Storm Lord's defenses

boss.name: The Storm Lord
boss.victory_condition: Damage the core using the Quantum Coil

level.objective: Navigate the Neon Tempest Nexus, defeat three foes, and conquer the Storm Lord

level.theme: A hidden oasis in a neon-lit city, where nature and technology coexist in fragile harmony. The level contrasts the usual cyberpunk grit with moments of quiet beauty, disrupted by corrupted AI guardians.
level.setting: A serene cyberpunk garden with glowing bioluminescent plants, tranquil water features, and hidden tech ruins. The atmosphere is calm but laced with subtle electronic hums and the distant sound of rain.
level.player_weapon: Seismic Gauntlet (unlocked at the start, enhanced by the geode)

enemy.name: The Garden's Guardian
enemy.weakness: Seismic energy (via the player's geomancy ability)

encounters.hazard: A field of reactive nanobots that swarm the player if they linger too long

pickup.name: Prismatic Geode
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of geomancy energy and grants a temporary geode (recharges seismic abilities)

encounters.trigger: Trigger the garden's security protocols by activating the geode

encounters.hazard: A maze of shifting corridors that collapse if the player's seismic energy is too low

pickup.name: Plasma Drill
pickup.effect: Unlocks plasma drill (a portable energy weapon that can pierce crystalline structures)

encounters.trigger: Destroy the Warden's energy core with the geode's resonance to open the path to the boss

enemy.name: The Rootbound Core
enemy.weakness: Plasma drill (obtained from the second encounter)

encounters.hazard: The ground pulses with unstable energy, causing random terrain shifts that can trap the player

pickup.name: Stabilized Geode
pickup.effect: Gains permanent access to the geode's enhanced seismic abilities

encounters.trigger: The Core awakens after the Warden's defeat, sensing the player's growing power

boss.name: The Rootbound Core
boss.weakness: Plasma drill (obtained from the second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Break the crystalline shield by targeting the geode interface with the plasma drill

level.objective: Navigate the Zenith Garden, dismantle the Neuro-Synaptic Warden, and defeat the Rootbound Core by exploiting its crystalline vulnerabilities with the plasma drill
level.reward: Access to the Core's data vault (contains blueprints for advanced geomantic tech)
